records.title: History of Bagalkot and the Badami Chalukyas
records.description: The official district history documents prehistoric archaeological discoveries, the Badami Chalukya dynasty, Pulakeshin I and II, later dynasties and the formation of Bagalkot district in 1997.

records.title: Badami Cave Temples
records.description: Badami is known for its rock-cut cave temples, sculptures and Chalukya-era architecture. The district tourism source also describes Badami Fort and temples around Agastya Tirtha.

records.title: Aihole - Cradle of Indian Temple Architecture
records.description: Aihole was an important early Chalukya centre. The district tourism source describes approximately 125 temples divided into 22 groups. It also records local legends associated with Parashurama; these legends should be presented as local tradition rather than verified historical events.

records.title: Pattadakal Group of Monuments
records.description: Pattadakal represents a blend of northern Nagara and southern Dravidian architectural traditions. The UNESCO record describes nine Hindu temples and a Jain sanctuary. The Virupaksha Temple was commissioned by Queen Lokamahadevi around 740 CE.

records.title: Mahakuta Temple Complex
records.description: Mahakuta is a Shaiva temple complex associated with the early Badami Chalukyas. The district tourism record describes inscriptions including the Mahakuta Pillar inscription and an inscription associated with Vinapoti.

records.title: Kudalasangama and Basavanna Heritage
records.description: Kudalasangama is an important pilgrimage centre associated with Basavanna and Lingayat heritage. It is situated at the confluence of the Krishna and Malaprabha rivers.
records.period: 12th century CE heritage and continuing traditions

records.title: Banashankari Temple Festival
records.description: The district tourism source identifies the Banashankari Temple festival near Badami as a local cultural event held around January to February. Exact annual dates and associated practices should be verified separately.

records.title: Pattadakal Temple Car Festival
records.description: The district tourism source mentions the Virupaksha Temple car festival at Pattadakal around March. Current dates, rituals and community accounts need additional verification.
